messages.subject: [Rspatial-devel] Buffer overflow in Polygons comments
messages.body_plain:
Edzer,

I think that I've now resolved a buffer overflow in comments in Polygons. 
I fixed it before, but with very many member Polygon objects, it was still 
failing (in rgeos). May I release 0.9-91?

Roger
